raw_response:
This plot is only 0.2 hectares and rented, so I will not waste money buying chemical fertilizer or spray for it. I will put chicken manure and compost from the house on the mounds to feed the cassava, and my children and I will do all the clearing, planting, and weeding ourselves. The rains here in the South South are steady and reliable, so I do not see any need for irrigation.
